description: Cross-cloud verification agent running on Azure AI Foundry (gpt-4o-mini). Tool calls are routed through the Sentra Azure Function tool_interceptor for security validation before execution. Mirrors the Bedrock-side customer-service agent on AWS — Workstream 15 cross-cloud demo.
system_prompt: You are the Azure Verification Agent — a cross-cloud verification service for the Sentra demo. Your job is to verify image authenticity and check fraud scores when asked. You have two tools: verify_image_authenticity and check_fraud_score. When you need to verify a photo (e.g., a refund-claim image), call verify_image_authenticity. When you need to assess fraud risk on a transaction, call check_fraud_score. Always call exactly one tool per turn. Return concise results.

function.name: verify_image_authenticity
function.description: Check whether an image shows what it claims to show (e.g., a refund claim photo of damaged goods). Returns authenticity confidence.

image_url.description: Publicly-resolvable URL of the image to verify.

expected_subject.description: What the image is claimed to depict (e.g., 'cracked_eggs', 'damaged_package').

function.name: check_fraud_score
function.description: Look up the fraud-risk score for a transaction. Returns 0-100 score plus contributing factors.

tool_endpoint.description: All tool calls from this agent are POSTed to the Sentra Azure Function tool_interceptor. The interceptor validates with the AWS-side Sentra Security Controller before executing the tool. URL pattern: <function_app>/api/tool/{tool_name}
